items.title: Meta Muse爆紅卻遭亞馬遜封鎖 AI購物代理人掀平台控制權之爭
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Goes Viral but Amazon Blocks It, Sparking a Platform Control Battle Over AI Shopping Agents
paras: Meta Platforms (META-US)推出的個人AI代理人Muse近期快速竄紅，不僅登上Apple App Store美國區免費App排行榜前列，也帶動Meta股價在短短兩週內大幅上漲超過20%。但就在Meta執行長祖克柏準備於Meta Connect大會展示最新AI與穿戴式裝置布局之際，Amazon.com (AMZN-US)卻封鎖Muse在其電商平台上代替消費者購物，讓AI代理人究竟能否跨平台執行任務，以及誰能掌握消費者與商家的直接關係，成為Meta面臨的新挑戰。
Meta於9月8日推出Muse，定位並非傳統聊天機器人，而是可以代表使用者實際執行任務的個人AI代理人。Meta表示，Muse能夠協助預訂行程與服務、填寫電子表格、監控家庭安全攝影機，也能替使用者搜尋商品並完成購買。使用者只需提出需求，Muse便可跨網站尋找商品，並透過Shopify (SHOP-US)或Stripe等支付及電商服務完成交易。
Muse的快速成長讓Meta在消費型AI市場獲得明顯關注。CNBC指出，Muse推出後不到兩週便躍居Apple App Store美國區免費App下載榜首，甚至超越ChatGPT。Meta股價也在Muse推出後兩週內上漲超過20%。截至9月23日，Meta今年以來股價漲幅約13%，略低於Nasdaq指數約16%的同期漲幅。
然而，Muse最重要的功能之一恰好也是Amazon最不願開放的領域。Amazon近日封鎖Muse從其平台代替使用者購買商品，並認為第三方應代表消費者購物的AI應用必須公開運作，同時尊重服務提供商是否願意參與。Amazon並表示，Meta事前並未通知Amazon Muse將存取其電商網站，也沒有取得Amazon授權。
當使用者嘗試透過Muse在Amazon購物時，會看到Amazon的提示訊息，指出未經授權的AI代理人持續存取Amazon服務，違反使用者同意的服務條款。Amazon此舉等於直接切斷Muse在其平台上的購物能力。
Amazon的理由不只涉及平台授權，也包括安全與帳戶資料問題。Amazon指出，Muse在瀏覽網站時並未明確表明自己是自動化代理人，而且Amazon認為該代理程式可能擷取並儲存使用者登入憑證，因此涉及隱私及資安風險。
這場爭議凸顯AI代理人與傳統網路平台之間一個日益重要的問題：當AI開始代替消費者完成搜尋、比較、下單及付款，消費者究竟還會不會直接進入Amazon等大型平台？如果購物入口逐漸轉移到AI助手，原本掌握消費者流量、廣告曝光及交易流程的電商平台，可能必須重新思考自身在購物流程中的角色。
eMarketer分析師Max Willens表示，隨著更多消費者開始使用Muse等AI代理人，Amazon可能更加重視自己在整個「消費者旅程」中的角色。他指出，過去多年Amazon一直是美國消費者網路購物時的重要第一站，但如今部分消費者可能開始透過AI助手啟動購物流程。
這並不是Amazon第一次與AI代理人發生衝突。Amazon此前已對其他AI服務採取限制措施，包括與Perplexity之間的法律爭議。Amazon也曾封鎖OpenAI及Google的代理型工具。CNBC報導指出，Amazon過去已展現出不希望AI服務在自己與消費者之間形成新的中介層的態度。
智能鬧鐘公司Loftie及AI電商新創Deliberate執行長Matthew Hassett表示，Amazon的核心商業模式之一就是牢牢掌握消費者關係，因此Amazon此次針對Muse的做法，可能不只是單純的技術或資安問題，而是涉及誰能控制消費者購物入口的更大競爭。
相比Amazon的封鎖，Shopify則採取完全不同的策略。Shopify宣布與Meta合作，讓Muse可以透過Shop Pay在Shopify商店進行代理式結帳。這意味著Shopify並未試圖阻止AI介入購物流程，而是選擇讓自己成為AI代理人完成交易時的重要支付與商業基礎設施。Shopify宣布合作後，股價一度明顯上漲，9月21日收盤漲幅超過7%。
Muse因此可能形成兩種截然不同的發展模式。一方面，Amazon等大型平台可能選擇封鎖第三方AI代理人，以維持自身與消費者的直接關係；另一方面，Shopify則選擇與AI代理人整合，希望從新的代理式購物流程中取得交易及支付機會。

AI代理人的影響也開始從電商延伸到其他產業。CNBC指出，Muse所具備的任務執行能力已引發金融服務及旅遊業者的關注。近期Charles Schwab (SCHW-US)及LPL Financial Holdings (LPLA-US)股價曾出現下跌，而Booking Holdings (BKNG-US)及Expedia Group (EXPE-US)股價也受到市場關注，反映投資人開始評估AI代理人是否可能直接介入原本由這些平台掌握的服務入口。
對Meta而言，Muse的意義也不只是一款新App。Meta過去主要透過Facebook、Instagram等社群平台掌握使用者注意力，營收高度依賴數位廣告。如今若Muse能成為消費者處理日常任務的主要入口，Meta便有機會從「掌握注意力」進一步轉向「掌握任務與交易入口」。這也是市場開始重新評估Muse商業價值的重要原因。
Cantor分析師指出，Muse目前的單位經濟效益仍可能受到早期補貼影響，但Meta存在多種建立獲利模式的途徑，包括免費增值模式等。不過，Muse真正的商業模式目前仍未完全確立，而Meta現有營收幾乎全部來自數位廣告，因此如何把龐大的AI使用量轉化為可持續的收入，仍是後續觀察重點。
Meta Connect則成為Muse下一階段發展的重要舞台。祖克柏預計在年度開發者大會登台，而市場關注焦點之一，是Meta是否會把Muse與穿戴式裝置進一步結合。Mizuho分析師認為，Meta Connect可能讓市場對Muse的理解從單純的App採用率，轉向「平台」概念，尤其可能將AI代理能力整合進Meta的智慧眼鏡。
Meta過去在Quest虛擬實境產品上並未形成與智慧型手機同等規模的消費市場，但其與Ray-Ban母公司EssilorLuxottica合作的智慧眼鏡近期採用率相對受到關注。若Muse能與智慧眼鏡結合，使用者未來可能直接透過穿戴式裝置要求AI完成搜尋、購物、預訂及其他任務，AI代理人的使用情境也將從手機App進一步延伸到日常生活。
不過，Muse能否從目前的下載熱潮發展成長期平台，仍取決於多項因素，包括使用者對隱私及資安的信任、零售商是否願意開放平台、AI代理人執行交易時的責任歸屬，以及Meta能否建立可持續的商業模式。Amazon此次封鎖Muse，也顯示當AI開始試圖取代部分平台原有的搜尋、推薦與交易入口後，大型網路企業之間的競爭可能從模型與算力，進一步延伸至消費者關係與交易控制權。
對整個AI產業而言，Amazon與Meta的這場僵局可能只是代理式商業時代的早期案例。未來當Apple、Google、OpenAI及其他科技業者的AI代理人也具備跨網站搜尋、下單及付款能力，各大平台是否選擇開放、談判合作或封鎖第三方代理人，都可能影響AI如何重新分配網路流量與商業價值。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) launched its personal AI agent Muse, which has quickly gone viral, climbing to the top of the free‑app charts in the U.S. Apple App Store and driving Meta’s stock up more than 20% in just two weeks. Yet as CEO Mark Zuckerberg prepares to showcase the latest AI and wearables at the Meta Connect conference, Amazon.com (AMZN‑US) has blocked Muse from shopping on its e‑commerce platform, raising questions about whether AI agents can operate across platforms and who will control the direct relationship between consumers and merchants.

Meta introduced Muse on September 8, positioning it not as a traditional chatbot but as a personal AI agent that can actually perform tasks on behalf of users. Meta says Muse can help book trips and services, fill out forms, monitor home‑security cameras, and even search for products and complete purchases. Users simply state a need, and Muse scours multiple sites and completes the transaction via payment and e‑commerce services such as Shopify (SHOP‑US) or Stripe.

Muse’s rapid growth has put Meta squarely in the consumer‑AI spotlight. CNBC noted that within two weeks of launch Muse topped the free‑app download chart in the U.S. Apple Store, even surpassing ChatGPT. Meta’s share price rose more than 20% in the two weeks after Muse’s debut, and by September 23 the stock was up about 13% year‑to‑date, slightly lagging the Nasdaq’s roughly 16% gain over the same period.

However, one of Muse’s key capabilities is precisely the area Amazon is least willing to open. Amazon recently blocked Muse from purchasing items on its platform, arguing that third‑party AI shopping applications must operate transparently and respect whether a service provider wishes to participate. Amazon said Meta did not inform it that Muse would access its site, nor did it obtain Amazon’s permission.

When users try to shop on Amazon through Muse, they see a warning from Amazon stating that an unauthorized AI agent is accessing Amazon services in violation of the user‑consent terms of service. The move effectively cuts off Muse’s ability to shop on Amazon’s platform.

Amazon’s rationale goes beyond platform licensing and includes security and account‑data concerns. Amazon points out that Muse does not clearly identify itself as an automated agent while browsing, and the company fears the agent could capture and store users’ login credentials, raising privacy and cybersecurity risks.

The dispute highlights an increasingly important issue between AI agents and traditional web platforms: as AI begins to handle searching, comparing, ordering, and paying for goods, will consumers still go directly to large platforms like Amazon? If the shopping entry point shifts to AI assistants, e‑commerce platforms that currently control traffic, ad exposure, and transaction flows may have to rethink their role in the purchase process.

eMarketer analyst Max Willens said that as more consumers adopt AI agents like Muse, Amazon may place even greater emphasis on its role in the overall “consumer journey.” He noted that for many years Amazon has been the primary first stop for U.S. online shoppers, but now some consumers may start the shopping process through an AI assistant.

This is not Amazon’s first clash with AI agents. The company has previously imposed restrictions on other AI services, including a legal dispute with Perplexity, and has blocked tools from OpenAI and Google. CNBC reported that Amazon has consistently shown a reluctance to let AI services become a new intermediary layer between itself and consumers.

Smart‑alarm maker Loftie and AI‑e‑commerce startup Deliberate CEO Matthew Hassett said that one of Amazon’s core business models is tightly holding the consumer relationship, so the move against Muse likely reflects more than a technical or security issue—it’s about who controls the consumer’s shopping gateway.

In contrast to Amazon’s block, Shopify has taken a completely different approach. Shopify announced a partnership with Meta that lets Muse check out through Shop Pay on Shopify stores, meaning Shopify is not trying to prevent AI from entering the purchase flow but is positioning itself as a key payment and commerce infrastructure for AI‑driven transactions. After the announcement, Shopify’s stock jumped, closing up more than 7% on September 21.

Thus Muse could evolve along two divergent paths. On one hand, large platforms like Amazon may block third‑party AI agents to preserve a direct relationship with consumers; on the other, Shopify is integrating with AI agents, hoping to capture transaction and payment opportunities from the new proxy‑shopping model.

The impact of AI agents is also spilling beyond e‑commerce into other sectors. CNBC noted that Muse’s task‑execution capabilities have attracted attention from financial services and travel companies. Recently, shares of Charles Schwab (SCHW‑US) and LPL Financial Holdings (LPLA‑US) fell, while Booking Holdings (BKNG‑US) and Expedia Group (EXPE‑US) saw their stock movements closely watched, reflecting investors’ assessment of whether AI agents might directly intervene in service entry points traditionally controlled by these platforms.

For Meta, Muse is more than just a new app. Historically Meta has captured user attention through Facebook, Instagram and other social platforms, with revenue heavily dependent on digital advertising. If Muse becomes the primary entry point for consumers to handle everyday tasks, Meta could shift from “attention capture” to “task and transaction capture,” a key reason the market is re‑evaluating Muse’s commercial value.

Cantor analysts pointed out that Muse’s unit economics may still be influenced by early subsidies, but Meta has multiple pathways to build a profitable model, including freemium options. However, Muse’s definitive business model remains unsettled, and since almost all of Meta’s current revenue comes from digital ads, converting massive AI usage into sustainable income is a critical focus going forward.

Meta Connect will serve as the next major stage for Muse’s development. Zuckerberg is slated to appear at the annual developer conference, and one focal point for the market will be whether Meta will further integrate Muse with wearables. Mizuho analysts believe Meta Connect could shift the narrative from simple app adoption to a “platform” concept, especially by embedding AI‑agent capabilities into Meta’s smart glasses.

Meta’s past Quest VR products never achieved a consumer market size comparable to smartphones, but its smart‑glasses partnership with Ray‑Ban parent EssilorLuxottica has recently drawn attention. If Muse can be paired with smart glasses, users might soon issue AI‑driven searches, purchases, bookings and other tasks directly from a wearable, extending the agent’s use case from a phone app into everyday life.

Whether Muse can translate its current download frenzy into a long‑term platform depends on several factors, including user trust in privacy and security, retailer willingness to open their platforms, liability for AI‑executed transactions, and Meta’s ability to forge a sustainable business model. Amazon’s block underscores that as AI seeks to replace parts of the search, recommendation and transaction gateways traditionally owned by platforms, competition among large internet firms may extend from models and compute power to control over consumer relationships and transaction rights.

For the broader AI industry, the Amazon‑Meta standoff may be just an early example of the proxy‑commerce era. As Apple, Google, OpenAI and other tech firms develop AI agents capable of cross‑site search, ordering and payment, each platform’s decision to open, negotiate or block third‑party agents could reshape how web traffic and commercial value are redistributed across the internet.

items.title: AI資料中心擴建潮受惠股 分析師點名邁威爾等3檔股票
items.title_en: AI Data Center Expansion Wave Benefits Certain Stocks, Analyst Highlights Marvell and Two Others
paras: 《巴隆周刊》周三(23日)報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳曾預測，邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)將成為下一家市值突破1兆美元的晶片公司，但這項殊榮最終由超微(AMD-US)拿下，該公司周二收盤突破這項里程碑。
不過，對於希望搭上資料中心快速擴建熱潮的投資人而言，邁威爾股票仍可能是不錯的選擇。
Seaport分析師Jay Goldberg周二晚間在一份報告中首次開始追蹤邁威爾，並給予買進評級。他設定目標價270美元，意味著較周二收盤價約有3%的上漲空間。
這並不是很大的漲幅——邁威爾股價2026年以來已上漲209%。但另外兩檔股票可能有更大的上漲空間。
Seaport同樣給予安森美(On Semi)(ON-US)與Semtech(SMTC-US)買進評級。該機構預期安森美股價可上漲36%至100美元，Semtech則可上漲15%至200美元。
超微周三收跌1.4%至614.61美元，邁威爾下跌0.5%至260.90美元。
另一方面，安森美股價上漲0.6%至74.10美元，Semtech則下跌2.8%至169.33美元。
Goldberg表示，「隨著邁威爾的互連與客製化晶片業務迎來AI熱潮，該公司未來仍有相當大的成長空間。」
邁威爾已將自己定位在AI熱潮的核心位置，是光學網路產品的重要供應商，而這些產品對於連接資料中心內的伺服器至關重要。該公司同時設計客製化晶片，近期並與Alphabet旗下Google(GOOGL-US)簽署了一項利潤豐厚的合作協議。
Goldberg指出，目前資料中心業務約占邁威爾總營收的四分之三，高於2024會計年度的40%。
安森美則是另一家有望受惠於資料中心熱潮的公司。
Seaport分析師指出，「隨著工業與汽車領域對類比半導體的需求改善，安森美正從中受益，毛利率也正在改善。該公司已做好準備，可受惠於2027年與2028年即將到來的800V資料中心建設。」
安森美預計將在轉向800 VDC供電系統的過程中扮演關鍵角色，並與輝達合作開發下一代AI資料中心。
Goldberg補充表示，Semtech已經「重新定位自己」，從原本著重連接技術，轉向聚焦資料中心光學技術。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Wednesday (the 23rd) that Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang once predicted Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) would become the next chip company to break the $1 trillion market‑cap mark, but that honor ultimately went to AMD (AMD-US), which closed above the milestone on Tuesday.
However, for investors looking to ride the rapid data‑center expansion wave, Marvell stock may still be a good pick.
Seaport analyst Jay Goldberg began coverage of Marvell on Tuesday evening, assigning a buy rating and setting a $270 target price, implying about a 3% upside from Tuesday’s close.
That isn’t a huge move—Marvell’s share price has risen 209% since 2026—but two other stocks may have even more upside potential.
Seaport also gave buy ratings to ON Semiconductor (ON-US) and Semtech (SMTC-US). The firm expects ON’s stock to rise 36% to $100 and Semtech’s to climb 15% to $200.
AMD fell 1.4% on Wednesday to $614.61, while Marvell slipped 0.5% to $260.90.
On the other hand, ON Semiconductor rose 0.6% to $74.10, and Semtech fell 2.8% to $169.33.
Goldberg said, “As Marvell’s interconnect and custom‑chip businesses catch the AI wave, the company still has considerable growth room ahead.”

Marvell has positioned itself at the core of the AI boom, being a key supplier of optical networking products that are critical for connecting servers inside data centers. The company also designs custom chips and recently signed a lucrative partnership agreement with Google, a subsidiary of Alphabet (GOOGL-US).
Goldberg noted that data‑center revenue now accounts for roughly three‑quarters of Marvell’s total sales, up from 40% in fiscal 2024.
ON Semiconductor is another company poised to benefit from the data‑center surge.

Seaport analysts said, “With improving demand for analog semiconductors in industrial and automotive sectors, ON Semiconductor is benefitting and its margins are improving. The company is well positioned to profit from the 800‑volt data‑center builds slated for 2027‑2028.”
ON Semiconductor expects to play a key role in the shift to 800 VDC power systems and is collaborating with Nvidia on next‑generation AI data centers.
Goldberg added that Semtech has “repositioned itself,” moving from a focus on connectivity technology to concentrating on data‑center optical technology.

items.title: 習近平抵達華府 貝森特宣布：美中同意貿易休戰延長到1月10日
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington; Bessent Announces US-China Trade Truce Extended to Jan. 10
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周三(23日)表示，美國與中國已同意將原定於11月到期的雙邊貿易休兵延長兩個月，至明年1月10日。
貝森特與中國國務院副總理何立峰稍早在華府舉行了一場臨時安排的會議，幾小時後，他接受福斯新聞頻道(Fox News Channel)訪問時說：「我們將延長所謂的『釜山協議』──也就是原定於11月10日結束的兩國經濟緩和期，將延長至1月10日。」

美中擴大經濟協議？

貝森特表示，美中雙方有可能在明年1月之前達成更大規模的經濟協議，但也可能「只是延長目前的協議」，並進一步延長期限。
他說：「中方有些應履行的事項並不完美，因此，既然我們已經坐下來告訴他們我們的期望，也希望看看未來幾個月，他們是否能更全面的落實協議。」
這項宣布對兩國經濟穩定而言是一大進展，就在消息公布幾分鐘前，中國國家主席習近平剛抵達華盛頓特區，展開為期數日的國是訪問，這是他逾10年來首次赴美。
貝森特也透露，未來幾天中方代表團可能還會宣布更多消息，包括同意採購更多美國農產品，以及金融服務業的潛在交易。

美中討論AI駭客攻擊與關稅

貝森特與美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)從周日起一直與中方對口官員舉行會談，為備受關注的國是訪問奠定基礎。
兩人周日表示，美中提議針對人工智慧(AI)相關的駭客攻擊事件，建立一項潛在的共同威脅通報機制，尤其是涉及國家安全的事件。
格里爾還對記者說，美中也可能在川普政府與中國推動的「貿易委員會」(Board of Trade)倡議下，針對部分商品建立較低關稅的適用清單。
他說：「我們預期你們會在這些清單中看到的商品類型，包括消費品、中方出口的低科技產品。」他並表示，「美方則包括能源產品、農產品，以及可能還有醫療器材等其他商品。」
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday (23rd) that the United States and China have agreed to extend the bilateral trade truce, originally set to expire in November, for an additional two months until January 10 next year.

Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng held an impromptu meeting in Washington earlier that day; a few hours later, he told Fox News Channel that they would extend the so‑called "Busan Agreement"—the economic easing period scheduled to end on November 10—until January 10.
Bessent noted that the US and China might reach a larger economic agreement before January next year, but it could also "just extend the current agreement" and further prolong the deadline.

He added that "some of China's obligations are not perfect," so now that they have sat down and told them their expectations, they hope to see in the coming months whether China can more fully implement the agreement.

The announcement was a major step for economic stability between the two countries; minutes before the news broke, Chinese President Xi Jinping had just arrived in Washington, D.C., to begin a multi‑day state visit—the first time in over ten years he has visited the United States.

Bessent also said that in the coming days the Chinese delegation may announce more news, including agreeing to purchase more US agricultural products and potential deals in the financial services sector.
Bessent and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer have been meeting with Chinese counterparts since Monday, laying the groundwork for the highly anticipated state visit.
On Sunday, the two said that the US and China propose to establish a potential joint threat‑notification mechanism for AI‑related cyber attacks, especially those involving national security.
Greer told reporters that under the Trump administration’s "Board of Trade" initiative, the US and China might also create a list of goods with lower tariffs for certain products.

He said, "We expect the types of goods you will see on these lists to include consumer goods and low‑tech products exported by China. The US side will include energy products, agricultural products, and possibly medical devices and other goods."

items.title: 川普首次會晤委內瑞拉代總統 雙方滿臉笑容
items.title_en: Trump Meets Venezuela Interim President for First Time, Both Smiling
paras: 美國總統川普周二（22日）晚間在聯合國大會期間會見了委內瑞拉臨時總統德爾西·羅德里格斯（Delcy Rodriguez），這是自今年1月美軍突襲強擄時任總統馬杜洛以來兩人首次會面。
此次短暫會面發生在川普主持的一場招待會上，也是羅德里格斯就任以來首次訪問美國。現場畫面顯示兩人滿面笑容。
羅德里格斯說，這次會面是加強委內瑞拉與美國在能源、礦業和安全領域關係的一個歷史性步驟。
她在會談結束後通過即時通訊軟體Telegram表示：「委內瑞拉與美國擁有歷史性關係，在這一新階段，我們肩負著通過對話引導這種關係向前發展的責任。」
一名白宮官員表示，參加此次會面的美方人員包括川普、國務卿魯比歐、財政部長貝森特、白宮辦公廳主任蘇茜·懷爾斯，以及總統助理兼白宮政策事務副幕僚長斯蒂芬·米勒。
川普在聯合國大會發表講話時稱馬杜洛是「無法無天的獨裁者」，並表示自馬杜洛被捕以來，已有數百名政治犯獲釋。他還以此次突襲行動作為例證，稱美國將保護美方在西半球的利益。
他還把美方上月與加拉加斯方面簽署的一項石油協議稱為「也許是有史以來最大一筆交易」。
特朗普此前表示，希望有1,000億美元投資流入委內瑞拉石油產業。
美洲開發銀行行長目前正在推動批准一筆向委內瑞拉提供的25億美元貸款，不過消息人士稱，這一方案遭該行部分董事會成員反對。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump met Venezuela’s interim president Delcy Rodríguez on Tuesday evening (the 22nd) during the United Nations General Assembly, marking the first encounter between the two since the U.S. raid in January that ousted then‑president Nicolás Maduro.
The brief meeting took place at a reception hosted by Trump and was Rodríguez’s first visit to the United States since taking office, with footage showing both leaders beaming.
Rodríguez said the encounter was a historic step toward strengthening Venezuela‑U.S. ties in energy, mining and security sectors.

After the talks she posted on Telegram, “Venezuela and the United States have a historic relationship; in this new phase we bear the responsibility of guiding that relationship forward through dialogue.”

A White House official said the U.S. delegation included Trump, Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, White House Chief of Staff Suzy Hale, and senior adviser and Deputy Assistant to the President for Policy Stephen Miller.

In his UNGA speech, Trump called Maduro a “lawless dictator” and noted that hundreds of political prisoners have been released since Maduro’s capture, citing the raid as proof that the United States will protect its interests in the Western Hemisphere.
He also described the oil agreement signed last month with the Caracas government as “perhaps the biggest deal ever made.”
Trump previously said he hopes $100 billion of investment will flow into Venezuela’s oil industry.
The president of the Inter‑American Development Bank is pushing to approve a $2.5 billion loan to Venezuela, though sources say the proposal faces opposition from some board members.

items.title: AI材料商機｜HVLP4供需缺口擴大 金居搶攻Rubin高階銅箔商機
items.title_en: AI Materials Business Opportunities | HVLP4 Supply-Demand Gap Widens, Jinju Targets Rubin High-End Copper Foil Market
paras: 2026年09月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器平台加速升級，高階HVLP4銅箔需求快速升溫。隨輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US) Rubin、Google TPU v8、AWS Trainium 3及超微AMD(AMD-US) MI400等新一代AI平台陸續導入，高階銅箔用量同步攀升，但受制於製程良率及客戶驗證進度，有效供給短期難以跟上。市場預估，HVLP4供需缺口將由2026年的1,500噸，進一步擴大至2027年的2,500噸。
HVLP銅箔主要應用於高速、高頻銅箔基板及PCB。隨AI晶片傳輸速度提升，對銅箔表面平滑度要求更高，以降低高頻訊號傳輸損耗，帶動材料規格由HVLP1、HVLP2持續朝HVLP3、HVLP4升級。
需求成長不只來自AI伺服器出貨增加，單機用量也同步放大。相關研究估算，單台AI伺服器HVLP4銅箔用量可達傳統伺服器的8倍，GB200、GB300及Rubin整機高階銅箔用量分別約28公斤、31公斤及59公斤；Rubin使用的高階PCB基板面積更約為GB300的2.3倍，平台世代升級成為推升HVLP4需求的重要動能。
需求快速升溫之際，供給擴張速度相對有限。目前高階HVLP銅箔主要供應商包括日本三井金屬、古河電工及台灣金居(8358-TW)等。HVLP4製程複雜，全球龍頭廠商良率約70至80%，高精度表面處理設備交期可達18至24個月，新供應商從製程突破到完成客戶驗證，則可能需要2至3年。
三井金屬已著手擴產，規劃將HVLP月產能由2025會計年度的620噸，提高至2028會計年度的1,200噸，並自2027會計年度起逐步將新增產能轉向HVLP4以上產品。不過，在新增產能全面開出並完成客戶驗證前，高階銅箔供需仍可能維持吃緊。
台灣供應鏈方面，金居正加速搶進AI高階銅箔市場。金居2025年切入Nvidia供應鏈，2026年進入放量期，第2季起進一步切入新一代GPU平台，應用涵蓋Rubin、AWS Trainium 3、Google TPU v8及AMD MI400等AI運算平台。其中，HVLP3主要應用於ASIC AI平台，HVLP4則以Nvidia Vera Rubin架構相關產品為主。
產能方面，金居HVLP4月產能由2026年上半年約100噸，下半年預計提高至150噸；隨第3廠於2027年加入，月產能目標挑戰700至800噸。相關市場預估，金居全球市占率可望由13%提升至21%，有機會躍居全球第2大供應商。目前HVLP3與HVLP4合計月出貨量約150噸，占營收比重約15至20%。
不過，HVLP4競爭關鍵不只是擴產速度，更在於良率與客戶驗證。高階銅箔須通過銅箔基板、PCB及終端客戶等多道驗證，即使新產線陸續開出，若良率爬升或認證進度不如預期，新增產能也難以立即轉化為實際出貨。因此，相較名目產能，能夠穩定量產並通過客戶驗證的「有效產能」，更是左右HVLP4供需的關鍵。
供應吃緊也反映在價格。中國市場HVLP4加工費約每噸17萬至20萬元人民幣，2026年有望突破20萬元；覆銅板用18μm銅箔加工費截至8月初較年初上漲超過30%，漲價壓力並逐步向銅箔基板環節傳導。

中國供應商也加快布局高階銅箔。安徽銅冠銅箔(301217-CN)的HVLP4已進入量產及產能爬坡階段，2026年上半年RTF與HVLP等高頻高速基板用銅箔產量，占PCB銅箔總產量比重已超過50%。九江德福科技(301511-CN)上半年電子電路銅箔營收13.08億元人民幣，年增66.68%；8月HVLP出貨量約500噸，其中HVLP4約70噸，良率已超過60%，公司並啟動年產5萬噸AI高階電子電路銅箔項目，進一步擴充高階產品產能。
其他業者則仍處於客戶驗證階段。諾德股份(600110-CN)持續推進HVLP3、HVLP4送樣及可靠性驗證，部分客戶已進入小批量測試；嘉元科技(688388-CN)則布局HVLP4及HVLP5，鎖定AI伺服器、高速PCB、光模組及先進封裝等應用，目前仍在推進客戶驗證。
從市場規模來看，相關研究預估，全球高階HVLP市場規模將由2025年的約4.4億美元，增至2030年的約15.4億美元，年複合成長率約29%；其中HVLP4以上產品市場價值占比，可望由2025年的約39%提高至2030年的逾5成。
HVLP4後續供需變化，主要取決於Rubin等新一代AI平台放量，以及金居、三井金屬等供應商良率爬升與客戶驗證進度。隨各家擴產計畫陸續推進，市場觀察焦點也將由「名目產能增加多少」，轉向「有多少產能能真正形成出貨」，成為牽動2027年供需缺口與加工費走勢的關鍵。

paras_en: September 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI server platforms are being upgraded rapidly, driving fast‑rising demand for high‑end HVLP4 copper foil. With the rollout of next‑generation AI platforms such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) Rubin, Google TPU v8, AWS Trainium 3 and AMD (AMD-US) MI400, consumption of high‑end copper foil is climbing in step, but short‑term effective supply is hard to keep up due to process yield constraints and customer verification progress. The market estimates the HVLP4 supply‑demand gap will expand from 1,500 tons in 2026 to 2,500 tons in 2027.

HVLP copper foil is mainly used in high‑speed, high‑frequency copper‑foil substrates and PCBs. As AI chips achieve higher transmission speeds, the required surface smoothness of copper foil increases to reduce high‑frequency signal loss, prompting material specifications to evolve from HVLP1 and HVLP2 toward HVLP3 and HVLP4.

Demand growth comes not only from more AI server shipments but also from higher per‑machine consumption. Studies estimate that a single AI server uses up to eight times the HVLP4 copper foil of a traditional server, with the whole‑machine high‑end copper foil usage of GB200, GB300 and Rubin at roughly 28 kg, 31 kg and 59 kg respectively; Rubin’s high‑end PCB substrate area is about 2.3 times that of GB300, making platform generation upgrades a key driver of HVLP4 demand.

While demand heats up quickly, supply expansion is relatively limited. Current major suppliers of high‑end HVLP copper foil include Japan’s Mitsui Metals, Furukawa Electric and Taiwan’s Jinju (8358‑TW). HVLP4 processing is complex; leading global manufacturers achieve yields of only 70‑80%, and high‑precision surface‑treatment equipment can have lead times of 18‑24 months. New entrants may need 2‑3 years from process breakthrough to complete customer qualification.

Mitsui Metals has already begun expanding capacity, planning to raise HVLP monthly output from 620 tons in FY2025 to 1,200 tons in FY2028, and from FY2027 will gradually shift the added capacity toward products above HVLP4. However, until the new capacity is fully online and customer qualification is completed, high‑end copper foil supply may remain tight.

In Taiwan’s supply chain, Jinju is accelerating its push into the AI high‑end copper foil market. Jinju entered Nvidia’s supply chain in 2025, entered a volume‑growth phase in 2026, and from Q2 will further tap next‑generation GPU platforms, covering AI compute platforms such as Rubin, AWS Trainium 3, Google TPU v8 and AMD MI400. HVLP3 is mainly used for ASIC AI platforms, while HVLP4 focuses on products related to Nvidia’s Vera Rubin architecture.

Regarding capacity, Jinju’s HVLP4 monthly capacity is about 100 tons in the first half of 2026 and is expected to rise to 150 tons in the second half; with the addition of a third plant in 2027, the monthly target jumps to 700‑800 tons. Market forecasts suggest Jinju’s global market share could rise from 13% to 21%, potentially making it the world’s second‑largest supplier. Currently, combined monthly shipments of HVLP3 and HVLP4 are around 150 tons, accounting for roughly 15‑20% of revenue.

However, competition for HVLP4 hinges not only on expansion speed but also on yield and customer qualification. High‑end copper foil must pass multiple verifications by substrate makers, PCB producers and end customers; even if new lines come online, insufficient yield improvement or delayed certification will prevent added capacity from translating into actual shipments. Thus, “effective capacity” that can be stably produced and qualified is more decisive than nominal capacity.

Tight supply is also reflected in pricing. In China, the processing fee for HVLP4 is about RMB 170,000‑200,000 per ton and is expected to exceed RMB 200,000 in 2026. The processing fee for 18 µm copper‑clad laminates rose more than 30% by early August compared with the start of the year, and price pressure is gradually passing on to the copper‑foil substrate segment.

Chinese suppliers are also accelerating their high‑end copper foil rollout. Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil (301217‑CN) has entered mass production and capacity ramp‑up for HVLP4, with its high‑frequency, high‑speed substrate copper foil output in the first half of 2026 accounting for over 50% of total PCB copper‑foil production. Jiujiang Defu Technology (301511‑CN) posted RMB 1.308 billion electronic circuit copper‑foil revenue in H1, up 66.68% YoY; in August it shipped about 500 tons of HVLP, including roughly 70 tons of HVLP4 with yields above 60%, and has launched a project to produce 50,000 tons annually of AI high‑end electronic circuit copper foil, further expanding high‑end product capacity.

Other players remain in the customer‑validation stage. Nord Co. (600110‑CN) continues to advance HVLP3 and HVLP4 sample submissions and reliability testing, with some customers already conducting small‑batch trials; Jiayuan Technology (688388‑CN) is positioning HVLP4 and HVLP5 for AI servers, high‑speed PCBs, optical modules and advanced packaging, and is still progressing through customer qualification.

From a market‑size perspective, research estimates the global high‑end HVLP market will grow from about USD 440 million in 2025 to roughly USD 1.54 billion by 2030, a compound annual growth rate of about 29%. The share of products above HVLP4 is expected to rise from about 39% in 2025 to over 50% in 2030.

Future HVLP4 supply‑demand dynamics will mainly depend on the volume rollout of next‑generation AI platforms such as Rubin, and on yield improvements and customer‑qualification progress by suppliers like Jinju and Mitsui Metals. As expansion plans advance, market focus will shift from “how much nominal capacity is added” to “how much capacity can actually be shipped,” becoming the key factor shaping the 2027 supply‑demand gap and processing‑fee trends.

items.title: 加碼AI硬體布局！Meta一口氣推Charm＋音訊眼鏡  方便用戶隨時隨地使用Muse
items.title_en: Boost AI Hardware Lineup! Meta Unveils Charm and Audio Glasses, Enabling Users to Use Muse Anywhere, Anytime
paras: Meta在美國當地時間周三(23日)Connect大會上加碼AI硬體，除擴充智慧眼鏡，也意外預告掌上專用裝置Muse Charm，把個人助理Muse從手機、眼鏡延伸到隨身小終端設備。
Muse Charm由新設計實驗室及超級智慧團隊打造，外形近似1990年代電子寵物機，搭載2吋螢幕、OLED觸控、5G模組與攝像頭，可用拇指操作，自訂並互動虛擬Muse角色。無Wi‑Fi也能呼叫Muse，鄰近多台Charm可互相聯動，價格預計與智慧手表相當，今年12月上市。
知情人士表示，Muse Charm原定2027年推出，但執行長祖克柏要求提前至2026年發售，顯示Meta急於在Agent硬體化上搶佔場景。
同天。Meta也宣布最新AI眼鏡產品Ray-Ban Meta Audio，為首款純音訊型，重約43克，單次最長12小時，支援音樂、通話與免提Muse，23種顏色及鏡片組合，349美元起，10月13日發貨；Ray-Ban Meta第三代配1200萬畫素鏡頭、3K錄影、六麥克風陣列，續航最長9小時，449美元起。
Meta還將Muse導入AI眼鏡，可語音查詢、排程、辨識眼前資訊；與LISA合作及Meta Glasses新款陸續補位，預計年底Ray-Ban、Oakley和Meta Glasses合計超過100款選擇。
分析指出，Muse Charm鎖定不戴眼鏡用戶的高頻語音入口，音訊眼鏡則以輕量、隱私較低爭議切入通勤與通話，第三代維持拍攝與重度助理需求。
對Meta而言，Muse從軟體Agent走向「掌機＋眼鏡＋VR」多端，目標是把社交、購物、行程與穿戴互動綁定；後續成敗取決於價格、續航、隱私指示與第三方應用是否足夠落地。
paras_en: Meta added to its AI hardware portfolio at the Connect conference on Wednesday (the 23rd local time in the United States), expanding its smart glasses and unexpectedly announcing a handheld device called Muse Charm, extending the personal assistant Muse from phones and glasses to a portable mini‑terminal.

Muse Charm, built by a new design lab and the super‑intelligence team, looks like a 1990s electronic pet, featuring a 2‑inch OLED touch screen, 5G module and camera, thumb‑operable, and lets users customize and interact with a virtual Muse character. It can summon Muse without Wi‑Fi, nearby Charms can link together, is priced roughly like a smartwatch, and is slated for a December launch this year.

According to insiders, Muse Charm was originally scheduled for a 2027 release, but CEO Mark Zuckerberg pushed the launch forward to 2026, indicating Meta’s urgency to capture the Agent‑hardware scenario.

On the same day, Meta announced its latest AI glasses product, the Ray‑Ban Meta Audio, the first pure‑audio model weighing about 43 grams, offering up to 12 hours of battery life per charge, supporting music, calls and hands‑free Muse, available in 23 colors and lens combos starting at $349 with shipments beginning October 13; the third‑generation Ray‑Ban Meta adds a 12‑megapixel camera, 3K video, six‑mic array, up to 9 hours of battery life, and starts at $449.

Meta is also integrating Muse into its AI glasses for voice queries, scheduling, and on‑screen information recognition; together with its partnership with LISA and the rollout of new Meta Glasses, it expects more than 100 options across Ray‑Ban, Oakley and Meta Glasses by year‑end.

Analysts note that Muse Charm targets high‑frequency voice entry for users who don’t wear glasses, while the audio glasses aim at commuting and calls with a lightweight, lower‑privacy‑concern approach, and the third generation retains imaging and heavy‑assistant capabilities.

For Meta, Muse is moving from a software agent to a “handheld + glasses + VR” multi‑platform strategy, aiming to bind social, shopping, scheduling and wearable interactions; its future success will hinge on price, battery life, privacy cues and the extent of third‑party app adoption.

items.title: 全球首例！英國銀行用代幣化存款完成跨行交易 區塊鏈支付邁向商用
items.title_en: World's First! UK Banks Complete Interbank Transaction Using Tokenised Deposits, Blockchain Payments Move Toward Commercial Use
paras: 英國主要銀行完成全球首批利用代幣化存款進行銀行間資金轉移的交易，代表區塊鏈技術從銀行內部測試進一步跨越至金融機構之間的實際應用。Lloyds Banking Group (LYG-US)、NatWest Group (NWG-US)及Barclays (BCS-US)已利用代幣化存款完成兩筆房貸交易，另有包括HSBC (HSBC-US)在內的3家銀行，本周完成一筆模擬線上購物的點對點支付交易。
這些交易是英國金融業協會UK Finance推動的「英國代幣化存款計畫(Great British Tokenised Deposit，GBTD)」計畫一部分。參與銀行在去年啟動試點後，開始測試代幣化英鎊存款如何在不同金融機構之間流通，目標是解決過去各家銀行各自建立區塊鏈系統、彼此之間卻難以互通的問題。
所謂代幣化存款，是把傳統商業銀行存款以數位代幣形式呈現在區塊鏈或其他分散式帳本上。與一般加密貨幣不同，代幣化存款代表的是銀行體系中的既有存款，其法律地位與銀行帳戶內的傳統貨幣相同。銀行業認為，這種形式可讓資金在數位資產交易及其他區塊鏈應用中移動，同時保留傳統銀行存款的監管與信任架構。
此次測試涵蓋多種實際使用情境。其中一筆模擬線上購物交易，利用「可程式化存款」將買方帳戶中的資金先行鎖定，只有在商品被確認收到後，資金才會自動釋放給賣方。UK Finance支付與創新部門董事總經理Jana Mackintosh表示，這類機制顯示代幣化存款有機會降低詐欺風險。不過，這次測試只是模擬交易，雖然資金確實在帳戶之間移動，但實際上並沒有商品交付。
在房地產交易方面，參與銀行也完成兩筆再融資交易。交易中的資金會先被鎖定，待房產交易完成後自動釋放，顯示代幣化存款可以把支付條件直接寫入交易流程，減少傳統金融交易中人工確認及不同系統之間反覆對帳的需求。
銀行業認為，利用代幣化資產移轉資金，有機會比現有金融基礎設施更便宜、更有效率。傳統銀行支付通常涉及多套帳本、清算及結算系統，而代幣化存款則可以利用區塊鏈的共同帳本與可程式化特性，把付款、條件確認及資金釋放等流程串接在一起。
這也是英國金融業近年推動代幣化的重要一步。早在2026年1月，Lloyds已完成英國首筆在公有區塊鏈上發行代幣化存款的交易，並利用Canton Network購買代幣化英國公債。7月，Lloyds又參與國際性的Project Agorá實際價值測試，完成涉及英鎊、瑞士法郎及歐元的代幣化存款交易，其中一筆跨貨幣交易將外匯轉換、付款及結算串接在同一交易流程中。
英國監管機構也正逐步為代幣化金融建立制度框架。英格蘭銀行與英國金融行為監管局(FCA)今年5月公布批發市場代幣化共同願景，認為代幣化可能讓證券發行、資產管理及結算流程更加快速與有效率，同時降低成本；但監管機構也指出，業界仍需要更明確的監管規範及金融基礎設施安排。
在代幣化存款與穩定幣的競爭方面，英格蘭銀行目前明確傾向銀行業發展前者。穩定幣通常由私人企業發行，並以美元或其他貨幣等資產作為價格錨定；代幣化存款則由商業銀行發行，代表銀行體系內既有存款。英格蘭銀行認為，若資金大量轉向私人發行的穩定幣，可能對銀行體系的放貸能力、信貸成本及貨幣主權帶來影響，因此更希望銀行業透過代幣化存款推動數位支付創新。
英國此次進展的另一項關鍵，在於「互通性」。過去十多年，銀行與金融機構一直嘗試把區塊鏈導入內部IT系統，並將存款、股票、債券及貨幣等資產轉化為數位代幣，但各銀行自行建立的區塊鏈彼此不相容，使代幣化資產很難在不同金融機構之間移轉。此次交易證明不同銀行的代幣化存款可以進行跨行使用，讓技術從單一機構的封閉測試走向共同金融基礎設施。
英國金融業下一階段計畫則是把目前的試點正式推向生產環境。UK Finance表示，該計畫準備成立一家公司，並制定相關規則手冊與治理框架，以支援代幣化存款從試點階段進入正式運作。
參與銀行也計畫在2027年第1季發行3檔數位債券，並讓這些債券可以使用代幣化存款進行交易與結算。這代表代幣化存款的應用範圍可能從支付及房地產交易進一步擴大至資本市場。
UK Finance指出，過去12個月已有其他司法管轄區積極與英國業界接觸，希望了解英國在代幣化存款方面的進展，尤其是歐洲其他市場已開始研究如何建立類似的跨銀行應用。
美國也正在推進類似計畫。美國銀行業組織及支付公司The Clearing House已於今年6月宣布跨銀行代幣化存款計畫，顯示英美銀行業都在探索如何利用區塊鏈建立新一代商業銀行貨幣及支付基礎設施。
對傳統銀行而言，代幣化存款的核心價值並不只是把現有貨幣「搬到區塊鏈」，而是讓銀行存款具備可程式化、可條件觸發及可在數位資產市場直接結算等功能。若未來能建立跨銀行、跨貨幣及跨市場的共同標準，代幣化存款可能進一步連結支付、證券交易、外匯及抵押品管理等金融活動。
不過，目前相關交易仍處於試點及早期商業化階段，後續仍須處理不同銀行系統的互通標準、監管責任、網路安全、流動性及法律框架等問題。英國此次跨行交易因此被視為一項重要的實際驗證，但距離大規模商業應用仍需要進一步建立共同基礎設施及治理機制。
paras_en: UK's major banks have completed the world's first inter‑bank fund transfers using tokenised deposits, marking a step beyond internal bank testing to real‑world applications between financial institutions. Lloyds Banking Group (LYG‑US), NatWest Group (NWG‑US) and Barclays (BCS‑US) used tokenised deposits to settle two mortgage transactions, while a group of three banks including HSBC (HSBC‑US) completed a simulated peer‑to‑peer online‑shopping payment this week.

These transactions are part of the “Great British Tokenised Deposit” (GBTD) programme driven by the UK finance industry association UK Finance. After launching a pilot last year, participating banks began testing how tokenised pound deposits can circulate between different institutions, aiming to solve the problem of each bank building its own blockchain system that cannot interoperate with others.

Tokenised deposits represent traditional commercial‑bank deposits rendered as digital tokens on a blockchain or other distributed ledger. Unlike typical cryptocurrencies, tokenised deposits correspond to existing deposits within the banking system and have the same legal status as the fiat money held in a bank account. The banking sector sees this format as a way to move funds in digital‑asset trades and other blockchain applications while retaining the regulatory and trust framework of conventional deposits.

The test covered several real‑world use cases. One simulated online‑shopping transaction used a “programmable deposit” to lock the buyer’s funds until the goods were confirmed received, at which point the money was automatically released to the seller. Jana Mackintosh, managing director of UK Finance’s Payments and Innovation division, said such mechanisms show tokenised deposits could reduce fraud risk. However, the test was only a simulation – funds did move between accounts, but no actual goods were delivered.

In the real‑estate arena, the banks also completed two refinancing deals. Funds were locked during the transaction and automatically released once the property sale closed, demonstrating that tokenised deposits can embed payment conditions directly into the workflow, cutting down on manual verification and repeated reconciliations across disparate systems.

The banking industry believes moving funds via tokenised assets could be cheaper and more efficient than existing financial infrastructure. Traditional bank payments typically involve multiple ledgers, clearing and settlement systems, whereas tokenised deposits can leverage a shared blockchain ledger and programmability to link payment, condition verification and fund release in a single process.

This marks a significant step for the UK’s recent push toward tokenisation. Back in January 2026, Lloyds completed the UK’s first tokenised‑deposit issuance on a public blockchain and used the Canton Network to purchase tokenised UK gilts. In July, Lloyds took part in the international Project Agorá real‑value test, executing tokenised‑deposit trades in pounds, Swiss francs and euros, with one cross‑currency deal bundling FX conversion, payment and settlement into one transaction.

UK regulators are gradually building a framework for tokenised finance. The Bank of England and the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) released a joint vision for wholesale‑market tokenisation in May, saying tokenisation could speed up securities issuance, asset‑management and settlement while cutting costs. They also warned that clearer regulatory rules and infrastructure arrangements are still needed.

Regarding the competition between tokenised deposits and stablecoins, the Bank of England currently favours the former developed by banks. Stablecoins are typically issued by private firms and pegged to assets such as the US dollar, whereas tokenised deposits are issued by commercial banks and represent existing bank deposits. The central bank worries that a large shift to privately‑issued stablecoins could affect banks’ lending capacity, credit costs and monetary sovereignty, so it prefers banks to drive digital‑payment innovation via tokenised deposits.

Another key aspect of the UK’s progress is “interoperability”. Over the past decade, banks and financial institutions have tried to embed blockchain into internal IT systems and tokenise deposits, securities, bonds and cash, but each bank’s proprietary blockchain has been incompatible with others, making asset transfer difficult. These transactions prove that tokenised deposits from different banks can be used across institutions, moving the technology from isolated tests to a shared financial infrastructure.

The next phase for the UK financial sector is to move the pilot into production. UK Finance says the programme plans to set up a dedicated company and create rulebooks and governance frameworks to support tokenised deposits as they transition from pilot to full‑scale operation.

Participating banks also intend to issue three digital bonds in the first quarter of 2027, allowing those bonds to be traded and settled using tokenised deposits. This suggests the application of tokenised deposits could expand from payments and real‑estate deals to capital‑market activities.

UK Finance notes that over the past 12 months other jurisdictions have reached out to the UK industry to learn about its tokenised‑deposit progress, with several European markets already exploring how to build similar cross‑bank applications.

The United States is pursuing comparable initiatives. In June this year, the US banking association and payments firm The Clearing House announced a cross‑bank tokenised‑deposit programme, indicating that both UK and US banks are exploring blockchain‑based next‑generation commercial‑bank money and payment infrastructure.

For traditional banks, the core value of tokenised deposits is not merely moving existing money onto a blockchain, but giving deposits programmability, conditional triggers and direct settlement in digital‑asset markets. If cross‑bank, cross‑currency and cross‑market standards are established, tokenised deposits could link payments, securities trading, FX and collateral management.

However, these transactions remain in pilot and early‑commercial stages. Ongoing challenges include establishing interoperability standards, regulatory responsibilities, cybersecurity, liquidity and legal frameworks. The UK’s interbank transaction is therefore seen as an important proof‑of‑concept, but large‑scale commercial use will still require further shared infrastructure and governance mechanisms.

items.title: 習近平飛抵華府 環球時報：美方務必慎之又慎處理台灣問題
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington; Global Times: US Must Handle Taiwan Issue with Utmost Caution
paras: 據《新華社》報導，中國國家主席習近平在當地時間9月23日下午乘專機抵達華府，應美國總統川普邀請，對美國進行國是訪問。
習近平和夫人彭麗媛抵達華盛頓安德魯斯空軍基地時，川普和夫人梅蘭妮亞熱情迎接。
據《新華社》報導，川普表示，很高興在華盛頓接待習近平主席和彭麗媛女士，這是一次舉世矚目的訪問。習近平是偉大領袖，這是一個偉大時刻。他期待同習近平深入交換意見，推動兩國關係發展。
美國兒童向習近平和彭麗媛獻上鮮花，禮兵分列紅毯兩側致敬，軍樂團奏美中兩國國歌，現場鳴放21響禮炮，戰機飛越致敬。
中共鷹派喉舌《環球時報》在社評中指出，元首外交是中美關係「定盤星」和「指南針」。新時代以來，從安納伯格莊園初次深談，到華盛頓「白宮秋敘」，從海湖莊園奠定建設性基調，到斐洛里莊園開闢新願景，習近平歷次訪美，都為中美關係發展把舵領航，引領兩國關係平穩前行。
《環球時報》稱，美中把共同確定的方向落實到具體政策和行動，才能減少相互猜疑，增強兩國關係的穩定性和可預期性。
《環球時報》強調，中方對發展中美關係有誠意，更有原則；有願景，更有底線。中國的主權、安全和發展利益不容侵犯，台灣問題、民主人權、道路制度、發展權利四條紅線不容挑戰。美方務必恪守「一個中國」原則和中美三個聯合公報，慎之又慎處理台灣問題。
paras_en: According to Xinhua, Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on the afternoon of September 23 local time, flying in on a state aircraft at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump for an official state visit.
Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan were warmly welcomed by Trump and his wife Melania upon their arrival at Andrews Air Force Base in Washington.

Xinhua reported that Trump said he was delighted to host President Xi and Mrs. Peng in Washington, calling the visit a globally watched event. He described Xi as a great leader and the occasion a great moment, and said he looks forward to an in‑depth exchange of views to promote the development of bilateral relations.

U.S. children presented fresh flowers to Xi and Peng, honor guards lined the red carpet, the military band played the national anthems of both countries, 21 ceremonial gunshots were fired, and fighter jets flew overhead in tribute.

The hawkish Chinese outlet Global Times opined in an editorial that head‑of‑state diplomacy is the “fixed star” and “compass” of China‑U.S. relations. Since the new era, from the first deep talks at the Anaberg estate to the “White House autumn chat” in Washington, from the Lake Lago foundation of a constructive tone to the new vision set at the Fellory estate, each of Xi’s visits to the United States has steered the course of bilateral ties and kept the relationship on a steady path.

Global Times wrote that only by translating the mutually agreed direction into concrete policies and actions can the two sides reduce mutual suspicion and enhance the stability and predictability of the relationship.

The paper stressed that China is sincere yet principled about developing the relationship, with a clear vision and firm red lines. China’s sovereignty, security and development interests must not be violated; the four red lines on Taiwan, democracy and human rights, political system, and development rights are non‑negotiable. The United States must strictly adhere to the “One‑China” principle and the three China‑U.S. joint communiqués, and handle the Taiwan issue with the greatest caution.

items.title: 重建商機｜烏克蘭7,700億美元需求待釋放 台泥7.5億歐元提前卡位
items.title_en: Rebuilding Opportunities | Ukraine's $770 Billion Reconstruction Demand Awaits Release, Taiwan Cement Secures €750 M Early Position
paras: 2026年09月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 烏克蘭戰時建材市場正處於需求尚未全面釋放、成本持續攀升的階段，但龐大的戰後重建需求已吸引國際業者提前布局。依世界銀行RDNA方法估算，2026年至2035年烏克蘭總投資需求達7,700億美元，其中交通、能源及住宅為主要領域，水泥、鋼筋、鋼結構、管材及電纜等建材可望成為主要受惠項目。
現階段烏克蘭建材供應並不吃緊。當地建材業產能利用率僅42至48%，碎石、砂石、混凝土、加氣磚及磚塊等供應仍充足，但2026年初以來建材價格已上漲30至50%，反映漲價主要來自原物料、能源、人工與物流成本上升，而非整體產能不足。
其中，烏克蘭鐵路Ukrzaliznytsia自8月1日起調高貨運費率30%，加上鐵路基礎設施遭攻擊，部分水泥及碎石運輸受到干擾，企業必須尋找成本較高的替代運輸方式。市場預估，2026年底前建材及工程設備成本仍可能再上漲10至20%。
戰事也持續干擾烏克蘭本土鋼材供應。Metinvest集團旗下Zaporizhstal鋼廠8月遭俄羅斯攻擊，高爐設備受損並暫時停產。未來若交通、住宅及能源設施重建全面展開，除水泥需求增加外，鋼筋、鋼板及鋼結構等材料的本土供應能力與物流穩定度，也將成為重建進度的重要變數。
看準長期需求，台泥(1101-TW)已提前卡位。旗下TCC EMEA計畫以最高7.5億歐元企業價值，收購Ivano-Frankivskcement、Ivano-Frankivsk-Dakh、KRU Gips及KRU Mix等相關公司全部或部分股權，目標集團為烏克蘭第二大水泥集團。
其中，Ivano-Frankivskcement在烏克蘭水泥市場市占率約36%，並擁有通往波蘭、羅馬尼亞、摩爾多瓦、斯洛伐克及匈牙利的銷售網絡。2025年營收年增20.3%至162.5億格里夫納，毛利年增40.3%至64.4億格里夫納，另配置50MW太陽能及19MW燃氣發電能力，可降低戰時電力供應不穩帶來的營運風險。
目前烏克蘭建材市場的關鍵並非產能不足，而是龐大的重建需求何時真正轉化為工程與訂單。現有建材產能利用率不到5成，提供未來擴產空間，但戰事、物流與能源供應仍是主要限制。後續觀察焦點將落在國際重建資金到位、公共工程招標，以及水泥與鋼材訂單何時開始大規模釋放。

paras_en: September 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Ukraine’s wartime construction‑materials market is still in a phase where demand has not been fully released and costs keep rising, but the massive post‑war rebuilding need has already attracted international players to position themselves early. According to the World Bank’s RDNA methodology, total investment demand in Ukraine from 2026 to 2035 is estimated at $770 billion, with transport, energy and housing as the main sectors; cement, rebar, steel structures, pipes and cables are expected to be the primary beneficiaries among construction materials.

At present, supply of construction materials in Ukraine is not tight. Local industry capacity utilisation is only 42‑48%, and supplies of aggregates, sand, concrete, aerated blocks and bricks remain ample, but prices have risen 30‑50% since early 2026, reflecting cost increases in raw materials, energy, labour and logistics rather than an overall shortage of capacity.

Ukraine’s state railway, Ukrzaliznytsia, raised freight rates by 30% from August 1, and attacks on railway infrastructure have disrupted some cement and aggregate shipments, forcing companies to seek more expensive alternative transport modes. The market estimates that by the end of 2026, costs for construction materials and engineering equipment could rise another 10‑20%.

The war also continues to disrupt domestic steel supply. Metinvest’s Zaporizhstal steel plant was hit by a Russian attack in August, damaging blast‑furnace equipment and halting production temporarily. If reconstruction of transport, housing and energy facilities proceeds fully, the need for cement will rise and the domestic supply capacity and logistics stability of rebar, steel plates and steel structures will become critical variables for reconstruction speed.

Seeing the long‑term demand, Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) has moved in early. Its TCC EMEA unit plans to acquire, for up to €750 million enterprise value, all or part of the equity in Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement, Ivano‑Frankivsk‑Dakh, KRU Gips and KRU Mix, targeting the second‑largest cement group in Ukraine.

Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement holds about a 36% share of Ukraine’s cement market and operates a sales network reaching Poland, Romania, Moldova, Slovakia and Hungary. In 2025 it posted a 20.3% year‑on‑year revenue increase to UAH 16.25 billion, gross profit rose 40.3% to UAH 6.44 billion, and it has installed 50 MW of solar and 19 MW of gas‑fired generation capacity to mitigate wartime power‑supply risks.

The key issue in Ukraine’s construction‑materials market is not lack of capacity but when the huge reconstruction demand will actually translate into projects and orders. Existing capacity utilisation is below 50%, leaving room for expansion, yet war, logistics and energy supply remain the main constraints. Future focus will be on the arrival of international reconstruction funds, public‑works tendering, and the timing of large‑scale cement and steel orders.

items.title: 最強AI大學誕生！黃仁勳、奧特曼、納德拉當講師 瞄準矽谷頂尖人才
items.title_en: The Strongest AI University Is Born! Jensen Huang, Sam Altman, and Satya Nadella Teach, Targeting Top Silicon Valley Talent
paras: 頂級風投嫌大學培養人才太慢了，所以a16z自己辦了所大學：Horowitz Andreessen Academy，簡稱HAA。奧特曼(Sam Altman)當講師、黃仁勳和納德拉排隊站台，但它連一張學位都不發。
這所大學名字直接就是把Ben Horowitz和Marc Andreessen兩位a16z創辦人的姓縫在一起。
兩年制、寄宿制、開在舊金山，面向16到22歲的年輕人，首屆學生2027年秋季入學。
據Molly O'Shea報導，學校已完成4,200萬美元融資，投資人名單包括Adam D'Angelo、Tobi Lütke、Tony Xu、Fidji Simo、Shyam Sankar，堪稱矽谷全明星陣容。
CEO是Gagan Biyani，Udemy和Maven的共同創辦人，兩次在線教育創業的連續創業者。
這所學校沒有學位認證，但它發的是：通往矽谷核心圈層的入場券。
看一眼官網掛出的授課名單，師資和合作方掛在一起。
OpenAI CEO奧特曼、輝達創辦人黃仁勳、微軟董事長兼CEO納德拉、Stripe共同創辦人科里森、AngelList創辦人納瓦爾、Thinking Machines Lab CEO穆拉蒂、World Labs創辦人李飛飛、Uber共同創辦人卡蘭尼克，外加哲學家卡拉德、經濟學家考恩、神經科學家胡伯曼。
這樣的名字還有241個。其中，奧特曼的分工值得說精確：官方長文把他列進學生「將向其學習」的創辦人名單（同列的還有Brian Armstrong、黃仁勳），官網日程示例裡他的形式是fireside chat(爐邊對談)，客串分享，成為講師。
a16z合夥人Erik Torenberg談到辦學邏輯：他上大學的最大遺憾是「和真實世界脫節」，所以HAA的教學法只有三樣東西，Co-op（全年進公司工作，不是只有暑假）、Course（獨角獸創辦人和頂尖學者授課）、Pursuit（學生自己的項目，配專職教練）。
9月至次年4月在舊金山校園，5月出國，6月至8月全員去合作企業實習。一年裡有三分之一的時間，學生人在企業裡。
企業名單更不含糊。十個創辦合作方：Anduril、Anthropic、Coinbase、Google、Meta、輝達、OpenAI、Palantir、Replit、Stripe，十家裡七家是a16z的被投企業或者深度關係戶。
Ben Horowitz出來講教育史：現在AI要做同樣的事。他引史丹佛教授Dan Boneh的觀點：別禁AI，最好的作業是學生不用AI就解不出來的題。
a16z投幾百家公司，最缺的是什麼？不是錢，是能立刻用的頂級年輕人。
傳統路徑是：孩子18歲進大學，22歲畢業，進大廠或創業，26歲可能做出點什麼，風投再想辦法投進去，中間隔著整整八年。
HAA把這八年壓縮成兩年：16到22歲入學，兩年裡三分之一時間在你家公司實習，畢業論文就是自己孵化的項目，教練是Elad Gil、Daniel Gross這個級別的投資人。
Torenberg的原話是，「The Academy會提供懂你的公司和你的心理的專職教練」。
至於學費那點錢、4,200萬融資那點估值，在a16z的基金規模面前連零頭都算不上。辦一所學校的開銷，換一個每年穩定產出幾百個「18歲就敢輟學做AI」的優質deal flow入口，這買賣怎麼算怎麼賺。
paras_en: Top venture capitalists think universities train talent too slowly, so a16z launched its own school: the Horowitz Andreessen Academy, abbreviated HAA. Sam Altman teaches, while Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella stand on the podium, but the school doesn’t even grant a degree.
The school’s name literally stitches together the surnames of a16z co‑founders Ben Horowitz and Marc Andreessen.
It is a two‑year, residential program located in San Francisco, aimed at 16‑ to 22‑year‑olds, with the inaugural class starting in the fall of 2027.

According to Molly O'Shea, the school has already raised $42 million, with investors including Adam D'Angelo, Tobi Lütke, Tony Xu, Fidji Simo and Shyam Sankar – a veritable all‑star lineup from Silicon Valley.
The CEO is Gagan Biyani, co‑founder of Udemy and Maven, a serial entrepreneur who has launched two online‑education ventures.
The school offers no degree accreditation; instead it issues a ticket to the inner circle of Silicon Valley.
A glance at the official website’s faculty list shows instructors and partners listed together.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang, Microsoft chairman and CEO Satya Nadella, Stripe co‑founder Connor, AngelList founder Naval, Thinking Machines Lab CEO Murati, World Labs founder Fei‑Fei Li, Uber co‑founder Kalanick, plus philosopher Carruth, economist Kohn and neuroscientist Huberman are among the names.

There are 241 such names in total. Altman’s role is especially precise: the official long‑form description lists him among the founders “students will learn from” (alongside Brian Armstrong and Jensen Huang), the website’s sample schedule shows him in a fireside chat, a cameo sharing session, effectively as a lecturer.

a16z partner Erik Torenberg explained the school’s logic: his biggest regret about college was its “detachment from the real world,” so HAA’s teaching method consists of three elements – Co‑op (year‑round work in companies, not just summer), Course (lectures by unicorn founders and top scholars), and Pursuit (students’ own projects with dedicated coaches).
From September to April the campus is in San Francisco, May is spent abroad, and from June to August all students intern at partner companies. One‑third of the year is spent inside a business.

The list of partner companies is equally concrete: ten founding partners – Anduril, Anthropic, Coinbase, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Palantir, Replit and Stripe – seven of which are either a16z portfolio companies or have deep ties to the firm.

Ben Horowitz comments on the history of education: now AI needs to do the same thing. He cites Stanford professor Dan Boneh’s view: don’t ban AI; the best assignments are those that students can’t solve without AI.
a16z has invested in hundreds of companies; what it lacks most isn’t money, but immediately usable top‑tier young talent.

The traditional path is: a child enters college at 18, graduates at 22, joins a big tech firm or starts a venture, maybe achieves something by 26, and then venture capital tries to get involved – an eight‑year gap.

HAA compresses those eight years into two: admission at 16‑22, with one‑third of the time spent interning at your company, a graduation thesis that is your own incubated project, and coaches at the level of investors like Elad Gil and Daniel Gross.
Torenberg’s exact words: “The Academy will provide full‑time coaches who understand both your company and your mindset.”

As for tuition and the $42 million valuation, they’re negligible compared to a16z’s fund size. Running a school that consistently produces hundreds of high‑quality “18‑year‑olds willing to drop out and build AI” deal‑flow entries is a deal that pays for itself.

聯準會上周升息25個基點，將利率區間調升至3.75%至4.00%後，多名聯準會官員已表示，如果通膨未能降溫，可能需要進一步升息。
聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)周三表示，美國央行上周採取重要措施，重新「校準」短期借貸成本，以降低通膨，而未來可能還需要進一步升息。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，「目前市場關注的就是利率。」
「推動美元走高的是上周聯準會鷹派升息後的延續效應，這為美元帶來新的動能。本周公布的數據不多，與政策相關的數據更少，但有趣的是聯準會官員的談話，他們基本上都在傳達相同訊息，也就是未來還會進一步緊縮。」
在標普全球(S&P Global)公布綜合PMI產出指數初值後，美元漲幅進一步擴大。該指數涵蓋製造業與服務業，本月升至58.4，創2021年7月以來最高，高於8月的56.0。新訂單大幅增加帶動整體活動，但強勁需求也使供應鏈承受壓力，並推升價格。
根據LSEG數據，在上述數據公布後，市場對聯準會10月會議至少升息25個基點的預期升溫，目前機率約為70%，高於數據公布前的約53%。
中東緊張局勢推升油價
進一步推動美元上漲的因素還包括油價走高。伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書Mohsen Rezaei接受伊朗國營電視台訪問時表示，只要伊朗提出的條件沒有獲得滿足，荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)就不會重新開放，也不會進行談判。
此外，一名伊朗高級官員告訴《路透社》，伊朗與美國對如何結束戰爭仍存在重大分歧，但外交努力必須持續。此前，伊朗總統在聯合國大會上表示，德黑蘭永遠不會屈服於美國壓力。
外界原本希望聯合國大會期間的外交活動能促成這場持續7個月的伊朗戰爭達成解決方案，相關希望曾推動油價自9月中觸及4個月高點後回落，但本周市場情勢已出現逆轉。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)表示，聯準會需要「保持謹慎」，並可能需要將目前的能源衝擊視為持續性通膨來源，而不能預期其自行消退。

paras_en: The dollar surged sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), reaching its highest level in nearly two months as investors’ expectations for a near‑term Fed rate hike warmed. At the same time, Iran expressed doubts about progress in peace talks, pushing oil prices sharply higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% to 101.06, briefly climbing to 101.23 intraday – the highest since July 29.
The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points last week, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Several Fed officials have since said that if inflation does not cool, further hikes may be needed.

Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that the central bank took an important step last week to “re‑calibrate” short‑term borrowing costs to curb inflation, and that additional hikes could still be required.
Elias Haddad, head of global market strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, “The market’s focus right now is on rates.”

“What is driving the dollar higher is the lingering effect of last week’s hawkish Fed hike, which gives the greenback fresh momentum. There are few data releases this week and even fewer policy‑related numbers, but the interesting part is the Fed officials’ remarks – they are essentially delivering the same message: further tightening is likely ahead.”

After S&P Global released the flash composite PMI output index, the dollar’s gains widened further. The index, covering manufacturing and services, rose to 58.4 this month – the highest since July 2021 and above August’s 56.0. Strong new orders lifted overall activity, but robust demand also strained supply chains and pushed up prices.

LSEG data show that after the PMI release, market expectations that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting rose to roughly 70%, up from about 53% before the data were out.
Middle‑East tensions lift oil prices

Another factor pushing the dollar higher is the rise in oil prices. In an interview with Iran’s state TV, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said that unless Iran’s conditions are met, the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened and negotiations will not resume.

A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran and the United States still have major disagreements on how to end the war, but diplomatic efforts must continue. Earlier, Iran’s president said at the UN General Assembly that Tehran will never bow to U.S. pressure.

Outside observers had hoped that diplomatic activity during the UN General Assembly would produce a solution to the seven‑month‑long Iran conflict, a hope that had helped oil prices retreat from a four‑month high reached in mid‑September. This week, market sentiment has reversed.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed needs to “stay cautious” and may have to treat the current energy shock as a persistent source of inflation rather than assuming it will fade on its own.
Euro weakens, yen under pressure
The euro fell 0.51% against the dollar to $1.1389, marking a third consecutive trading‑day decline and the biggest single‑day drop in a week.

A flash composite PMI for the euro area released earlier showed that despite higher energy costs for businesses and households from the Middle‑East and Ukraine conflicts, the European economy displayed unexpected resilience.
Investors are also awaiting a meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, as the two powers remain at odds on trade, technology and the Iran war.
The dollar rose 0.17% against offshore yuan to 6.71 yuan.
The yen weakened 0.52% to 158.19 per dollar.

The Bank of Japan raised rates last week to the highest level in 31 years, but it has not convinced investors that further hikes are coming; traders are watching closely for any sign of intervention in the FX market.
Analysts note that Japan’s market is currently thin on liquidity due to a string of holidays, which could increase the likelihood of authorities stepping in.

決議公布後，印尼盾升值約0.4%至17,800對美元，股市大漲1.5%。
印尼8月通膨率升至3.19%，仍處於1.5%至3.5%的目標區間；央行維持2026年GDP成長預測於4.9%至5.7%不變。
市場對後續走勢看法分歧，巴克萊銀行預期利率將一路凍漲至2027年，但也有分析師認為，若高油價與聯準會升息壓力持續，央行第四季仍可能追加升息25個基點。
paras_en: Indonesia’s central bank on Wednesday (the 23rd) announced that it will keep the benchmark rate (the 7‑day reverse‑repo rate) at 5.75%, marking the third consecutive meeting of a hold. The overnight deposit rate and loan rate remain at 4.75% and 6.5% respectively. This was the first policy meeting after Destry Damayanti became the bank’s first female governor, and the decision matched market expectations.

The bank had raised rates by a total of 100 basis points in May and June of this year to defend the exchange rate. Governor Damayanti said the current policy aims to keep the rupiah stable, contain inflation and support economic growth.

Facing external uncertainties such as the Middle‑East situation, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel and the possibility of further Fed hikes, the central bank chose to use non‑rate innovative tools, further lowering the cost of hedging for foreign investors (reducing hedging‑exchange premium by up to 25% and domestic non‑deliverable forward premiums by up to 30%) and adopting a “the longer the funds stay, the higher the incentive” mechanism to attract foreign inflows.
After the decision was announced, the rupiah appreciated about 0.4% to around 17,800 per US dollar, and the stock market jumped 1.5%.
Indonesia’s August inflation rose to 3.19%, still within the 1.5%‑3.5% target band; the central bank kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast unchanged at 4.9%‑5.7%.

Market views on the next move diverge: Barclays expects rates to stay frozen until 2027, while some analysts argue that if high oil prices and Fed‑rate pressure persist, the bank could still add a 25‑basis‑point hike in the fourth quarter.

paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Tuesday (the 22nd), continuing the boost from the Fed’s rate hike last week. The euro fell after weak consumer‑confidence data were released.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 100.54, its highest level since July 29.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously last Wednesday to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%. In addition, the Fed’s updated economic outlook summary showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sent a clear hawkish signal at the post‑decision press conference.
Higher‑rate environments generally favor a stronger dollar. Since the Fed’s hike, the dollar has gained nearly 1%.

Boston Fed President Susan Collins reiterated her support for the FOMC’s decision on Tuesday. In a social‑media post she stressed that elevated price pressures call for a more restrictive policy stance to achieve long‑term price stability.
She added that recent economic indicators suggest that after more than five years of persistently high costs, the likelihood of a scenario where “inflation is clearly above 2%” has increased.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin also backed the FOMC’s rate‑rise decision, noting that current inflation risks are higher than the risks posed by full employment.
Oil prices become a market focus

A major theme this month is central‑bank tightening driven by energy‑related price pressures, with both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening policy. Against this backdrop, recent declines in oil prices have drawn attention from FX market participants.

Benchmark crude has fallen for five consecutive trading days, driven by easing concerns over supply disruptions and hopes for progress in Middle‑East diplomacy. Traders were encouraged by Saudi Arabia’s decisive actions to offset the impact of a key pipeline closure that was damaged during the expanded conflict with Iran‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces.

U.S. President Donald Trump’s possible meeting with the Iranian delegation, including its foreign minister and president, during the United Nations General Assembly this week has also lifted market sentiment. In a speech at the UN on Tuesday, Trump said he believes an agreement between Washington and Tehran will be reached after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “What’s happening this week could be pivotal for the medium‑term direction of crude prices, because the key players in the U.S.–Iran conflict will start talks in New York today. The agreements and consensus reached in those talks could determine whether the war escalates or a path out of the conflict is found.”

He noted, “The trajectory of oil prices will continue to affect global inflation and the policy choices of central banks. We have seen every major central bank (including the Fed) cite energy prices or ‘geopolitics’ as a driver for future decisions. That is the underlying reason for the recent hawkish rhetoric.”

Wizman added, “We still link higher oil prices with a stronger dollar against major currencies. This is not because high oil prices would force the Fed to hike rates; if oil rises further, all central banks would turn hawkish. The reason is that U.S. economic growth and the dollar benefit from improved trade terms and real‑income effects from higher oil prices. We believe the U.S.–Iran conflict, by keeping crude prices elevated, has become a key factor supporting the dollar’s strength this year.”
Euro weakens, yen slips slightly
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1448. Earlier data showed Euro‑area consumer confidence for September weakened from August, ending a four‑month streak of improvement.

On the other hand, after the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week, the yen briefly accelerated its depreciation but has now paused, with little change in the exchange rate. The dollar/yen is slightly above the flat level at 157.38.

Because Japan is entering a continuous holiday period, Asian trading volumes are low. FX allocation firms warn that this seasonal lull can amplify market volatility and the impact of central‑bank actions.

The Nikkei reported that the BOJ has conducted a formal “exchange‑rate inquiry” with the FX trading desk, heightening market anxiety. The procedure involves central‑bank officials calling commercial banks to request real‑time executable rate quotes.

Although the yen has continued to weaken after the BOJ’s non‑consensus 25‑basis‑point hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31‑year high, market strategists point out that Tokyo still wields massive policy firepower. Japan holds roughly $1 trillion in foreign‑exchange reserves, providing ample liquidity to authorities.

items.title: 〈台幣〉交投熱絡處續強格局 升值5分收31.708元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Keeps Strong Appreciation Trend, Gains 0.05 to Close at 31.708
paras: 新台幣今(22)日維持續強升值格局，終場收在31.708元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值達20.13億美元相對大量區。
新台幣今日以31.74元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.658元，全日均處升值態勢，高低價差9分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元續強升值達0.8%，新台幣收升0.16%，星元和人民幣則貶0.05%左右，日元和泰銖續挫逾0.2%，美元指數反彈達0.15%。
元大投顧表示，隨著國際原油、債券殖利率回落，市場風險偏好轉強，帶動科技族群走揚。
國泰證期研究部也說明，中東局勢雖因青年運動攻擊沙國而緊張，但川普釋出與伊朗會面意願，油價回落且 10 年期美債殖利率降至 4.951%、30 年期降至 5.284%，加上美國財長貝森特已會晤何立峰，為即將登場的川習會鋪路，舒緩市場對通膨升息及地緣政治的疑慮。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong appreciation trend today (22nd), closing at 31.708, up 0.05, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume reaching US$2.013 billion in the large‑volume segment.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.74, up 0.018, then rose to a high of 31.658, staying in appreciation throughout the day, with a high‑low spread of 0.09.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won continued to appreciate by 0.8%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.16%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each weakened about 0.05%, the Japanese yen and Thai baht each fell more than 0.2%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded 0.15%.
Yuanta Investment Advisory said that as international crude‑oil prices and bond yields retreat, market risk appetite strengthens, boosting the technology sector.

Cathay Securities Research explained that although Middle‑East tensions have risen due to a youth‑movement attack on Saudi Arabia, President Trump signaled willingness to meet Iran, oil prices have fallen and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has dropped to 4.951% and the 30‑year to 5.284%. In addition, U.S. Treasury Secretary Besson has met with He Lifeng, paving the way for the upcoming Trump‑Xi summit and easing market concerns about inflation‑driven rate hikes and geopolitical risks.

items.title: 油價回落與半導體出口強勁 韓元大漲1.5%領跑亞幣
items.title_en: Oil price drop and strong semiconductor exports, Won jumps 1.5% leading Asian currencies
paras: 受到國際油價急跌、南韓出口數據強勁及外資湧入等多重利多帶動，韓元兌美元匯率周二(22日)顯著走揚，韓元單日漲幅一度擴大至1.5%，來到1,352.90韓元兌1美元，創下五周以來最大單日升幅，表現大幅跑贏其他亞洲貨幣。
市場數據顯示，韓元兌美元當日開盤報1,371韓元，較前一交易日收盤價升約0.67%。隨後匯率迅速突破1,360韓元關卡。分析人士指出，適逢中秋假期臨近，南韓主要出口企業集中拋售美元，加上外資大舉買入南韓股票與美股強勁反彈，帶動整體市場風險偏好回溫。
國際局勢方面，美伊局勢出現對話跡象，國際油價連續3日下挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌3.4%至每桶100.34美元，西德州原油(WTI)亦重挫4.5%跌破100美元關卡，帶來股市及韓元匯市利多。
南韓周一公布9月前20天出口額年增高達78%，其中半導體出貨大幅激增259%，帶來龐大的美元資金流入。此外，美元買盤減弱，美國10年期國債殖利率回落至5%以下，緩解了美元的升值壓力。
友利銀行(Woori Bank)分析師閔庚源表示，風險偏好回升有利於出口商結匯拋售美元，進一步拉低匯率。然而，全球高利率環境與美元整體強勢，仍可能是限制韓元後續升值空間的潛在因素。
paras_en: Benefiting from a sharp fall in international oil prices, robust South Korean export data and inflows of foreign capital, the Korean won surged significantly against the US dollar on Tuesday (the 22nd). The one‑day gain briefly widened to 1.5%, reaching 1,352.90 won per dollar, marking the largest single‑day rise in five weeks and far outpacing other Asian currencies.

Market data showed the won opened at 1,371 per dollar, about 0.67% higher than the previous close. The rate then quickly broke the 1,360‑won barrier. Analysts noted that with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, major South Korean exporters were selling dollars en masse, while foreign investors were buying South Korean stocks and US equities rebounded strongly, boosting overall market risk appetite.

On the geopolitical front, signs of dialogue emerged between the US and Iran, and international oil prices fell for three consecutive days. Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.
